categories_thin: Retail (non-food): South Plainfield's retail is heavily concentrated in three chain-dominated centers (Hadley Center, Hadley Commons, Oak Park Commons). Genuine independents are few; only about 8 were found and several (Furniture X-Change, Deffego) are unverified in category.
Independent hotels: only chain-flagged properties appear (Holiday Inn, Best Western, Ramada) - all excluded by the chain rule, so this category is legitimately empty.
Locksmiths and security installers: only directory-level entries found (no own websites), so details are thin.
Photography: studio listings exist but several operate from residential addresses; few have verifiable business addresses.
Tutoring/test prep: mostly franchise brands (Kumon, Sylvan, Eye Level, Genie Academy), which were excluded; only PALS was confirmed independent.
Auto repair: abundant, but nearly all appear only on a single bulk directory (Loc8NearMe) with no phone numbers.
caveats: Excluded by rule: chains/franchises present in town - Great Clips, Meineke, Mavis Discount Tire, Penske Truck Leasing, Ryder, Estes Express, Con-Way, Planet Fitness, LA Fitness, School of Rock, Kumon, Sylvan, Eye Level, ATA Black Belt Academy, MaidPro, Arrow Pest Control, Petro Home Services, Scott Specialty Gases (Air Liquide), Rainbow Shops, The Children's Place, Payless, Fashion Bug, Staples, Best Western, Ramada, Holiday Inn.
Excluded by rule: pharmacies (Drug Mart, Twin City, Durham, Peter Pan, Smile, Broadway Health, CVS, ShopRite), supermarkets, and all restaurants/cafes/bakeries/delis found along the way.
Excluded by rule: large sites - Smurfit Westrock, Viant Medical, GE Healthcare, Umicore, Advantest, Gannett Fleming. Hospitals/health systems and banks also excluded.

Group B topics (salons, barbers, nail spas, med spas, dentists, chiropractors, gyms) were deliberately not collected - they belong to another zone brief; several appeared incidentally in sources and were skipped.

Many C/D entries come from a single bulk directory (NJ Business Directory, WhereOrg, Cylex, Loc8NearMe). They are labelled 'one directory only' in active_evidence and need confirmation by the triage team.

Where two directories gave different towns or names for the same address (A&J Professional Services, Clinton & 7th / Sullivan's, The Perfume Box / French Perfume), the entry notes the discrepancy rather than picking one.
Phone numbers are recorded only where a source displayed them; 'Unknown' means not seen, not necessarily unpublished.
Several industrial addresses are multi-tenant buildings (e.g. 450 Oak Tree Ave, 4041 Hadley Rd, 4475 S Clinton Ave, 3461 S Clinton Ave); different companies at one address are separate entries.
As a rough size check, heavy-civil and multinational names (Conti Enterprises, Crisdel, Steelite International) are flagged as borderline on the 500-staff rule rather than excluded outright.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was not queried successfully; no OSM extract contributed.

Yellow Pages, ChamberofCommerce.com, FindOpen and Cylex index pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; Yellow Pages content was used only through search-result snippets, so some addresses/phones from that source are partial.

Google Maps / Bing Maps were not browsed (no browser tools in this brief), so there is likely a tail of small owner-operated trades (handymen, one-truck landscapers, home-based tutors) that appear only on map listings.
South Plainfield Business Association (thespba.biz) returned only a landing page with no member directory reachable, so chamber membership could not be cross-checked.
BBB category pages were reachable only via search snippets; full BBB listings were not enumerated.
The New Jersey licensed trade-contractor registry was not consulted, so contractor license status is unverified for all group C entries.
No attempt was made to verify whether listed businesses still operate in 2026 beyond directory recency; 'one directory only' entries may be stale.
